We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the compound at hand, which we can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. We need to determine number of methyl groups (CH3) in the unknown molecule. We can use proton NMR to see signals for methyl (singlet, doublet, etc). Also carbon NMR for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Could also use HSQC to correlate.

We need to minimize experiments. Perhaps we can get proton NMR first. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool.
